question: Where did the Indian wrestling drama Dangal take most of its box office?
answer: In China. Released there in May 2017, months after its Indian opening, Aamir Khan's film about a father who trains his daughters to wrestle took around $190 million, more than it earned at home. For a while a Hindi film's biggest crowds were queuing in Chinese multiplexes.
move: A product's home market is not always its biggest one.
reference: Variety, Why 'Dangal's' Triumph in China Could Be a Game-Changer for India, 2017, https://variety.com/2017/film/asia/why-dangal-china-triumph-changes-could-be-game-changer-1202439053/
